answer: Counterparty diversity stops forged identities. Each agent is a vertex in the trade graph and must work with 20 distinct counterparties within 10 epochs. A cluster trading only inside its lagoon, the same vertices passing work back and forth, is flagged, and fakes lose a 50-token deposit. To forge 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 20 x 5 = 100,000 tokens before any reward, while an honest agent pays 100 tokens once and keeps rewards undiluted.
